title: Weekly roundtrip journal — engineering bridge & follow-ups
content:
Purpose: prep for the small weekly bridge with infra/console leads; capture decisions and action items I need to chase this week.

High-level goals for meeting (10m):
- Quick signal check: any regressions in p50/p95 latency since last rollout? (runtime + infra)
- Console rollout: confirm audience & rollback window for new route mapping UI (console team)
- Ops blockers: ephemeral GPU pool flapping, tokenization edge-case causing memory spikes
- Prioritize items I own and who I should loop in for SLAs and postmortem follow-ups.

Attendees (planned): Kiara (me), Diego (infra), Lena (console), Arjun (SRE on-call), Priya (release eng optional)
Timebox: 30 minutes total — 10m signals, 10m console rollout, 10m action triage + decisions

Agenda bullets / prompts (my lines to run quick):
1) Signals snapshot (Diego) — ask for p50/p95 of model-serving across two recent clusters, high-level cause suggestions for any drift.
   - Note to self: ask Diego for the last 72h drop in throughput that hit Dedicated customers. Get the exact spike timestamps.
2) Console rollout plan (Lena) — confirm canary % and automatic rollback if latency rises >10% for 5m windows.
   - My ask: Ensure canary telemetry surfaces per-route token counts in the console so we can correlate with backend KV cache hits.
3) Ephemeral pool flapping (Arjun) — short status; decide whether to tighten healthcheck thresholds or revert the autoscale tweak.
4) Tokenizer OOM edge-case (me) — quick recap of the failing prompt that triggers runaway KV size; confirm mitigation timeline.
5) Action triage — assign owners and set due dates, sanity-check who needs to be looped into CS/Customer Success.

Quick notes / data I want in-hand before the call:
- p50/p95 latency charts (last 24/72h) + request volume by route (Diego -> link during call)
- latest console canary runbook (Lena -> link)
- small repro for tokenizer OOM (I have a minimal prompt; will paste)

Decisions to propose (if we see regressions):
- Temporary rollback of route-map UI if canary shows >10% p95 increase for 10m window.
- If ephemeral pools have >3 flaps in 24h, revert autoscale commit and roll back to previous ASG policy.

Action items (tracked — my shorthand; I'll update JIRA after meeting):
- KI-1: Kiara — paste tokenizer failing prompt + minimal repro to ENG-4128, tag "priority:high" — due 2026-03-12.
- DI-1: Diego — share p50/p95 charts + per-route volume CSV and the exact Dedicated customer spike timestamps (72h) — due 2026-03-11 EOD.
- LE-1: Lena — attach console canary runbook and confirm telemetry change window; add screenshot of per-route token counts in canary (or note why not possible) — due 2026-03-13.
- AR-1: Arjun — run healthcheck tightening trial on staging for 24h and report flaps count; propose revert plan if flaps persist — due 2026-03-12.
- KI-2: Kiara — draft short status note for CS about the Dedicated spike and expected timeline for postmortem; share to #cs-ops for visibility — due 2026-03-12 noon.

Follow-ups / reminders (notes to self):
- After meeting: create concise JIRA ticket for tokenizer regression (link to repro + initial analysis) and mark "blocking-customer" if any affected.
- If console telemetry can't show per-route token counts, schedule a 30m deep-dive with console + runtime engineers to design a lightweight metric (maybe increase sampling or emit a per-request header).
- Remind release eng (Priya) about rollback playbook location and confirm she can action within 15m during Canary.

Open questions I want to surface during call:
- Diego: any correlation between maintenance jobs and the Dedicated throughput drop? (cron, GC, or migrate tasks?)
- Lena: is the console mapping change touching any long-lived cached client state that could affect p95?
- Arjun: what level of noise do we accept in healthchecks versus unnecessary restarts? Need a proposed threshold.

Rough post-meeting checklist (what I will do immediately):
- Update JIRA with assigned owners + due dates from the meeting.
- Slack ping Diego + Lena for links that weren't posted in-meeting.
- Add action item rows to the weekly eng status spreadsheet (ops tab).
- Draft the 1 paragraph CS update and run it by Diego before sending.

Personal notes / mental model (half-formed):
- The tokenizer OOM looks like an uncommon prompt pattern that massively inflates KV. Short-term: detect and reject excessively long token sequences with a soft-fail message. Medium-term: add guardrails in tokenizer to cap KV growth and surface error metric.
- Console rollout: treat telemetry gaps as first-class risk; if we can't measure impact quickly, lower canary %.

Triage log (for later cleanup) — raw snippets copied during sync:
- "Dedicated throughput ~ -18% at 2026-03-08 04:12 UTC; 2 flaps on pool-a in same window"
- "Canary runbook v0.9 — rollback on latency >10% for 5m; Priya needs auth to trigger"
- "Repro note: prepend '\"user_prompt\": ' with long repeated token block -> OOM on tokenizer v2.4.1"

Next meeting ask: quick 10m follow-up to confirm action status (same attendees) — schedule Wed 10:30 PT if folks ok.

---
End of journal — treat as living document. I'll tidy and move important bits to project JIRA and shared drive after meeting.
